clusters.headline: She quit school twice. Her horror art studio nearly closed. Now, its neon art jams book out most weekends
clusters.summary: An IP student at an elite school, Merida Lim left with only a PSLE certificate to open a horror-themed art studio at 19. When it nearly closed, she pivoted to neon art jams and the business now generates five figures in monthly revenue. This is the first instalment of CNA Women’s Gen Z series.

clusters.headline: What is the best way to tackle poverty in Ethiopia? This new study tries cash, therapy, and more.
clusters.summary: A new study is out that looked at various ways to try to tackle poverty in Ethiopia. Turns out, cash helps, but the impact of therapy is less clear.
